text:
devon: RCA draft uploaded — link: https://redwood.docs/rca/INC-2025-47-draft. Please skim the timeline and the mitigation action list, looking for gaps.
caroline: thanks — quick Q, timeline shows stateful cache eviction at 02:16 but pager says 02:14. which is authoritative?
devon: pager is authoritative for the initial signal. timeline item was from the cache logs; I adjusted wording but not the timestamp. quick patch below:
```
02:13:22 - pager triggered (error spike)
02:14:05 - autoscaler scaled up
02:16:12 - cache eviction observed in logs
02:20:30 - degradation indicators resolved for most customers
```

ajay: we should call out customer-facing impact numbers in the summary — ops dashboard shows ~3% failed requests for 18m across hosted API, not just "brief degradation". that will affect severity.
maria: action owners: who will own the post-release cache guardrail? I can take the follow-up if no one else.
eli: I can pick up the guardrail implementation (feature flag + threshold). assigning to eli in the doc now.
caroline: +1 on clarifying impact. can we add a short table of affected routes and the percent error per route? keeps exec summary concrete.
devon: will add the table and update the timeline to match pager times. also adding an explicit "customer impact" paragraph with numbers Ajay shared.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-47 | Pager start: 2025-10-12T02:13:22Z | Pager end: 2025-10-12T02:45:07Z | Bridge: ended (duration 31m45s).
legal: please ping us before the doc is public. we need to check the customer wording and confirm no PII or contractual language.
maria: noted. @legal will review before public share.
ajay: one more ask — can we add a short note on fallback policy that didn't trigger? it's an important contributing factor (routing policy mismatch).
devon: good call. adding a contributing factor: "fallback routing policy misconfigured, delayed failover to dedicated-capacity variant". will propose a remediation: automated failover test in staging + runbook update.
eli: ETA on guardrail PR is EOD Thu. I'll link the branch in the RCA once opened.
caroline: can we set a peer-review deadline? propose tomorrow 11:00 PT — if no comments by then we'll mark as ready for sign-off.
maria: 11:00 PT works for me.
ajay: good for me.
legal: we'll try to review in that window but may need until EOD. will flag anything urgent sooner.
devon: thanks everyone. I'll make the timeline and impact updates now and ping when ready for review. :thumbsup: 
caroline: thanks — remember to version the doc (v1.1) and include the short changelog at the top. then we can move to sign-off flow.
devon: done — v1.1 uploaded, changes include timeline alignment, impact table, assigned owners, and added fallback contributing factor. link: https://redwood.docs/rca/INC-2025-47-v1.1
caroline: quick read: LGTM pending legal wording. setting reminder to reconvene 11:05 PT in this thread for final sign-off. :calendar:
